blurb:
Beach Horseback Ride & Alcatraz – One Epic Coastal Escape!
Saddle up for one of California’s most thrilling day trips—a scenic horseback ride on the beach + a legendary visit to Alcatraz Island! Start your adventure with complimentary hotel pickup in San Francisco, then cruise down the stunning Pacific Coast to charming Half Moon Bay.

Feel the salty breeze as you ride horseback along the beach with breathtaking ocean views—no experience needed! After a relaxing seaside lunch or casual seafood stop, sail across the bay to Alcatraz Island. Enjoy panoramic views and a self-guided audio tour of the infamous prison.

✔️ Ride along the beach with jaw-dropping views
✔️ Includes Alcatraz tickets, ferry & hotel pickup (drop-off not included)
✔️ If fog cancels the ride, we’ll switch to a magical forest ride near Stinson Beach!

No shorts allowed. Height & weight required.
Spots fill fast—book now for your unforgettable coastal escape!
